name: steer
description: Harness hooks that steer agent behaviour, independent of any skill.

interface.longDescription: Claude Code checks Markdown edits and requests a recap when appropriate. Codex and Copilot CLI default to recaps after Opus 5 or Fable turns that changed something. Devin does not provide a transcript to plugin hooks. Its UserPromptSubmit hook reminds the agent to ask before editing Markdown. It does not block edits or request a recap.
